summary: test(auth): cover SES bounce shapes and the EmailBounce model
description:
Because:

* No test ran the EmailBounce stored procedures on MySQL, where the earlier bounce errors happened.

This commit:

* Adds an #integration - EmailBounce describe that round-trips each SES bounce shape through createEmailBounce_3 and fetchEmailBounces_4.
* Adds an sp_emailBounces.sql fixture that copies both procedures from the fxa migration patches.

Closes FXA-12838
